feeds.title: The Quad Life
feeds.description: I have been a quadriplegic most of my life, through all its twists and turns. I've learned to expect the unexpected, and to rely on God's care and plan at all times.

feeds.title: typical guy, atypical situation
feeds.description: Quadriplegic. Widower. Seeker. Survivor. Trying to do life the way my wife taught me; one day, one breath and, at times, one heartbeat at a time

feeds.title: Determined2Heal
feeds.description: The Determined2heal Foundation provides strategic information on Spinal cord injury, treatment, cure, research, exercise, equipment, rehabilitation, and types of spinal cord injuries. The Founder of Determined2Heal, Josh Basile, a C4-5 quadriplegic has been a champion for the spinal cord injury community since his 2004 injury.

feeds.title: The Life Quadriplegic
feeds.description: The exciting adventures of a quadriplegic powerchair user.

feeds.title: Happy On Wheels Blog
feeds.description: Hi. I'm Sheri Denkensohn-Trott, and am an aspiring public speaker who is a long-time quadriplegic and a breast cancer survivor. - Happy on Wheels is a business in Arlington, Virginia aimed at helping people, with and without disabilities, to identify tools to live happier lives.

feeds.title: Quirky Quad Diaries
feeds.description: I intend to share all aspects of life as a quadriplegic with you as well as the crazy exploits of my life before I broke my neck considering I lived on the edge for 27 years before my accident. I tend to approach life with a dark sense of humor and make the most out of every situation whether that be intensely terrifying or insanely comical.

feeds.title: Struggling with Serendipity Blog
feeds.description: A mom with a story ​to share about injuries that never heal and fortunate accidents. About guilt, disability, perspectives, and unexpected adventure

feeds.title: New Dawn ~ New Day ~ New Life
feeds.description: On July 27, 2013, our lives changed forever. My husband, Jeff, sustained a spinal cord injury and became a ventilator-dependent quadriplegic. This blog is about how Jeff, our daughter Evie, and I have dealt with life during and since his injury

feeds.title: Diary of a Quadriplegic
feeds.description: When I woke up from my fall, I tried to move and immediately knew that I was paralyzed. This blog is about my journey as a quadriplegic.

feeds.title: Tracy Todd Brave Lotus Flower
feeds.description: Living life, paralysed from the neck down, out loud.

feeds.title: Shane Clifton
feeds.description: Shane had an accident on a pushbike that left him a quadriplegic (C5 incomplete). He is a crip theologian, an ally of feminism, and an open-minded Christian.

feeds.title: Spinal Cord Injury Research and Science
feeds.description: Spinal Cord Injury Research and Science Report. The place for serious news & education about spinal cord injury. Opinions my own.

feeds.title: Noah's Miracle
feeds.description: Today, Noah has the diagnosis of hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy resulting in spastic quadriplegia cerebral palsy with athetoid movements. Noah's miracle has brought our story to all of you.

feeds.title: Nika Maples
feeds.description: When I was 20 years old, my plans for my life, career, family, and future fell apart. One day I was an active sophomore in college, the next I was quadriplegic in the Intensive Care Unit. No matter what you are going through, you need encouragement. You will find plenty of it here.

feeds.title: Mum Making Lemonade
feeds.description: A blog about my amazing daughter, Elin who is living with Cerebral Palsy and making Lemonade every day!

feeds.title: The Daily Life of a Quadriplegic
feeds.description: A blog about a paralyzed quadriplegic in her daily life.

feeds.title: Diary Of A Gimpy Kid
feeds.description: A fanspastical account of life as a quadriplegic, 12 years down the line...

feeds.title: All the Beautiful Things
feeds.description: Beautiful people, places, ideas, and dreams that catch my eye from all walks of life. Destiel shipper. Fanfiction writer. Indie author. Supporter of all other ships. Represent your fandom with dignity and grace.

feeds.title: The Witch in a Wheelchair
feeds.description: Chronicling the learning process and development of a solitary witch who happens to also be a quadriplegic.
